routes.processing: ⏳ Got your message, I’ll be back with an answer.
routes.unknownCommand: This command isn’t available yet. Try the menu or /start.

bodyMeasurements.initialMessage:
📏 Send your body measurements.

You can write everything in one message in any format — I’ll figure it out.

For example:
weight 78.4, waist 84, chest 101, hips 97, thigh 56
bodyMeasurements.editPrompt: ✏️ Send the corrected body measurements in one message — I’ll parse them.
bodyMeasurements.tooSoon:
⏳ Body measurements can be saved once every 30 days.

Your previous measurements are still too recent, so I didn’t save this update.
bodyMeasurements.invalidInput:
❌ I couldn’t recognize the body measurements.

Send them again in one message in any format — I’ll figure it out.
bodyMeasurements.unavailable:
🚧 Body measurements are still getting ready for launch.

For now, keep tracking your numbers — we’ll connect them here soon.

workoutLogging.initialMessage:
🏋️ Workout logging started!

Describe one exercise at a time — for example: bench press, 4 sets of 10 reps, 60kg.

Send /end_workout when you’re done.
workoutLogging.notAClient:
Workout logging isn’t available for you yet.

Once you’re set up as a client, you’ll be able to log workouts here.
workoutLogging.alreadyOpen:
You already have a workout-logging session open.

Send /end_workout to finish it before starting a new one.
workoutLogging.unclear:
❓ I couldn’t quite catch that.

Tell me the exercise, how many reps, and how many sets (and the weight, if it’s a weighted exercise) — one more try!
workoutLogging.savedAsWritten: 📝 Saved as you wrote it: “{description}” — not linked to the catalog.
workoutLogging.confirmation:
Got it: {exercise}, {reps} reps × {sets} sets{weight}.

Which one is it?
workoutLogging.sessionEmpty: 👌 Workout ended — nothing was logged this time.

conversations.cancelled:
👌 OK, that wasn’t saved.

We can come back to it when it’s convenient.
conversations.safeError:
Something didn’t go as planned.

Try sending your message again.
conversations.unsupportedAction: This action isn’t available right now.
conversations.unsupportedInput: I can’t use this message right now.

empty.title: No measurements yet
empty.hint: Add 2+ measurements to see a trend.

insight.title: Insight
insight.text: Талія зменшується, поки вага залишається контрольованою. Схоже на рекомпозицію тіла, а не просто схуднення..
insight.noDataText: No measurements yet. Add your first weight or body measurement, and I will start building a useful progress insight from the next check-ins.
